claim: Model-driven deployment with explicit authority boundaries. The current dependency map and environment configuration supply a grant plan; application reports each binding’s result, while cloud IAM enforces installed permissions. The typed call model remains a verified mirror checked against the map. Service-name correspondence checks a different property.
topology: Flexible engineering judgment selects intended calls. A typed call contract is checked by parity against the current authoritative dependency map. That map and environment-specific deployment identities feed deterministic grant derivation, a concrete grant plan, application, and per-grant results. Installed IAM bindings govern invocation at a separate runtime boundary. Service-name correspondence is not an IAM check. Moving model authority requires a separate consumer migration.
bw_encoding: Rectangles are models or durable artifacts, rounded rectangles mechanisms or flexible reasoning, and diamonds decisions. Heavy outlines mark selected enforcement boundaries; gray identifies flexible reasoning. Solid arrows carry data/artifacts; dashed edges carry verification or correspondence.
redesign: Author-approved simplification removes only the future authority-migration note; parity, live IAM and fix-forward distinctions remain.
